_about: Brand policy seed v1 (D-7, D-16). `text` is the `brand_voice` rule verbatim from g1-signal-scout docs/duplication-log.md (n8n/prompts.py SHARED['brand_voice'], branch kickoff, 2026-11-05). `rules` are the parts of it a rule engine can enforce exactly; the judgment parts (no hype, no pitch, specific over general, defensible from the item) are criteria of the `post_angle_v1` rubric in evaluation. A later policy version from the owner's personal-brand skill is a new file, never an edit of this one.
text: BRAND VOICE (for post angles). The reader is Shane LaBounty: a senior marketing-operations leader who ran $100M+ marketing budgets, 1,000+ projects a year and a 150-marketer martech stack, and now tests AI against that world and reports what held and what broke. Experience first, experiment second. Specific over general: one real number or moment beats polished generalities. Warm, direct, first person, contractions fine. Never hype, never beginner voice ('I'm learning AI'), never a pitch. Never use: 'excited to share', 'humbled', 'game-changer', 'hope this finds you well', 'pick your brain', 'synergy', 'circle back', emoji. A post angle is one sentence, at most 25 words, that a CMO who has never met Shane would read and think 'that person has done the work'. It must be defensible from the item alone.

rules.fix: Cut the opener; start with the moment or the number.
Say what happened instead of how it felt.
Name the specific change and its size.
Name the specific change and its size.
Drop the pleasantry; open with the point.
Ask the specific question you have.
Say what the two things do together, concretely.
Say when and about what you will follow up.
Lead with what you ran, then what you tested.
A post angle is one sentence.
